title: the recent offer worth *testing now*
dek: A last-seven-day authority audit and live market refresh comparing the 15-Ad Creative Test Pack, Lead-to-Proposal Proof Sprint, and health evidence-to-message AI workflow—without reviving the parked Angle Map.
lens: authority · pmf · icp · avatar · linkedin · ai pathway
sources: current primary, supplier, marketplace, and local decision records

sections.heading: the corrected verdict
sections.body:
Test the 15-Ad Creative Test Pack: five materially different creative bets, 15 launch-ready Meta statics, and a learning map in seven business days for an already-advertising health or performance brand.

Keep Lead-to-Proposal as a separate fastest-cash workflow hypothesis. Earn the health AI workflow as a second rung after paid delivery. Angle Map remains supporting IP and is ineligible as the primary offer. Every exact offer remains UNTESTED / NO EVENT until payment clears.

sections.heading: the buyer, pain, and product
sections.kicker: ONE SKU · ONE TEST SLATE · ONE LEARNING LOOP
sections.dek: The buyer must already have spend, data, approved claims, and someone ready to launch.

items.why: Already-selling supplement, recovery, beauty, fitness, or performance brand actively running Meta and able to share winners, losers, and one SKU.
The brand produces more creative without testing meaningfully different beliefs, mechanisms, proof, or funnel jobs.
Five concepts, three meaningful variants each, 15 finished statics, a launch map, and one readout; $1,000 prepaid; seven business days.
No media buying, creator sourcing, ROAS promise, unsupported claims, legal review, or unlimited revisions.

sections.heading: what is still unknown
sections.body: There is no collected deposit, verified Farrice DTC performance case study, or proven seven-day delivery economics. Marketplace listings and supplier pages prove category activity and public pricing, not demand for Farrice's exact package. LinkedIn can support vendor evaluation but cannot substitute for qualified conversations and payment.
